project.title: Cooking Together: Healthy Meals on a Student Budget
project.description: Four hands-on cooking sessions in a community kitchen, led by a professional chef, where international students learn to prepare affordable, nutritious meals from different cultures. Many students rely on cheap takeaway because they are short of time and money, which affects their health and energy. Each session ends with a shared meal so participants can build friendships.
project.who_can_attend: All international students in the Northern Territory are welcome, from any country and any education provider. Places are free.
project.wellbeing_benefit: Participants will eat better on a limited budget, feel less isolated, and gain practical life skills that support their physical and mental health.
